title: put-back
description: What in the working copy goes back to the drive as the open key's person's work, file by file, and why or why not; or, asked with the files the report named, those written on the drive.

written.description: Whether the files that go back were written on the drive: only when they were named, and were exactly the ones the report gave.

by.description: Whose work goes back: the open key's person.

drive.description: The drive the copy came from, the only one work goes back to.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes in the copy, as it is named to put it back; empty when it is gone from the copy.

files.description: Every file changed in the copy since it was taken, whether it goes back, and why or why not.

back.description: The paths that go back: what to name to write them.
